name: agentforge-interview-synthetic-smoke
description: Synthetic public smoke dataset for local benchmark verification.

documents.title: Architecture
documents.text: The application separates a Spring Boot API, a React client, and infrastructure adapters. Controllers coordinate use cases while services own business rules.

documents.title: Async jobs
documents.text: Resume analysis and document vectorization run through Redis Streams. Producers persist a pending task and consumers acknowledge it after a successful update.

documents.title: Hybrid retrieval
documents.text: The retrieval pipeline combines BM25 lexical scores with pgvector cosine similarity and an optional reranker. Query length controls the candidate top K.

documents.title: Provider registry
documents.text: A provider registry stores OpenAI-compatible base URLs, chat models, embedding models, and encrypted API keys. One provider can be marked as the default.

documents.title: Structured output
documents.text: StructuredOutputInvoker validates JSON against a schema and retries with a repair prompt when the model returns malformed data.

documents.title: File deduplication
documents.text: Uploaded files are hashed with SHA-256 before storage. A repeated hash reuses the existing object and avoids duplicate vectorization work.

documents.title: Voice interview
documents.text: The voice workflow uses WebSocket messages for session state, realtime ASR subtitles, and streamed TTS audio. A silence debounce prevents premature commits.

documents.title: Evaluation
documents.text: Interview answers are evaluated in batches and persisted as a report with category scores, evidence, and a final recommendation.

documents.title: Object storage
documents.text: The storage adapter uses the AWS S3 SDK so RustFS, MinIO, and other S3-compatible endpoints can share the same application contract.

documents.title: Database schema
documents.text: Flyway owns the relational schema and creates the vector extension and HNSW index. Hibernate runs in validate mode in production.

documents.title: Security controls
documents.text: Provider credentials are encrypted at rest, benchmark endpoints require a local token, and uploaded files are checked against allowed media types and size limits.

documents.title: Observability
documents.text: Actuator health checks and Micrometer Prometheus metrics expose task latency, provider calls, and failure counters for operational dashboards.
